description: This is the main include file for the ADODB PHP database abstraction layer library. It defines core classes, constants, and functions used for database connectivity, query execution, transaction management, caching, and metadata handling within the library.

classes.name: ADOFieldObject
classes.description: Helper class representing metadata about a database field/column.

classes.name: ADODB_Cache_File
classes.description: Class implementing file-based caching of recordsets.

classes.name: ADOConnection
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a database connection, providing methods for connection management, query execution, transactions, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ADOFetchObj
classes.description: Helper class representing metadata about a database field/column.

classes.name: ADODB_Iterator_empty
classes.description: Iterator implementation over an empty recordset.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_empty
classes.description: A lightweight recordset class representing an empty dataset.

classes.name: ADODB_Iterator
classes.description: Iterator over a recordset, allowing row-by-row traversal.

classes.name: ADORecordSet
classes.description: Represents a dataset returned by the database, providing methods for data retrieval, navigation, and formatting.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array
classes.description: Encapsulates a recordset created in memory as an array, supporting data initialization, field access, navigation, and metadata.

methods.name: ADODB_Setup
methods.description: Initial setup/configuration of global ADODB settings and constants.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the library version string.

methods.name: setCustomMetaType
methods.description: Defines a custom metadata type for database field types.

methods.name: getCustomMetaTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of custom metadata types.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server version and description info.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the connection is active.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Return all records as a 2D array, optionally limited by $nRows.

methods.name: CacheGetAll
methods.description: Retrieve cached records or execute query and cache if not available.

methods.name: CacheGetArray
methods.description: Retrieve array of data from cache or execute and cache.

methods.name: GetRow
methods.description: Return the first row of a query as an array, executing the query if necessary.

methods.name: CacheGetRow
methods.description: Retrieve a single row from cache or execute query if cache miss.

methods.name: updateBlob
methods.description: Update a BLOB column with data from a string.

methods.name: updateBlobFile
methods.description: Update a BLOB column with data read from a file.

methods.name: BlobDecode
methods.description: Decode BLOB data; default implementation returns input.

methods.name: BlobEncode
methods.description: Encode BLOB data; default implementation returns input.

methods.name: getCharSet
methods.description: Retrieve the current character set of the client connection.

methods.name: setCharSet
methods.description: Set the character set for the client connection.

methods.name: UserDate
methods.description: Format a date string according to user preferences.

methods.name: UserTimeStamp
methods.description: Format a timestamp string as per user settings.

methods.name: UnixDate
methods.description: Convert a date string in YYYY-MM-DD format to Unix timestamp.

methods.name: UnixTimeStamp
methods.description: Convert a timestamp string in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format to Unix timestamp.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Return an iterator over the recordset.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Close the recordset and release resources.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advance to the next record in the recordset.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Fetch all remaining records as an array.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Move to a specified row number in the dataset.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Retrieve the value of a specific field in the current row.

methods.name: GetArray
methods.description: Retrieve the data array from the recordset.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Access a specific field in the current row, supporting associative or numeric modes.

methods.name: FetchField
methods.description: Retrieve metadata about a specific field in the recordset.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Map native database field types to ADODB standard types.

methods.name: _updatefields
methods.description: Convert the case of the fields array keys based on configuration.

methods.name: absolutePage
methods.description: Set or get the current page when paginating recordsets.

methods.name: AtFirstPage
methods.description: Set or get the at-first-page flag for pagination.

methods.name: LastPageNo
methods.description: Set or get the last page number in pagination.

methods.name: AtLastPage
methods.description: Set or get the at-last-page flag for pagination.
